newsitem.title: USA: Jason Inc to acquire Buller Buff Co.
newsitem.headline: Jason Inc to acquire Buller Buff Co.

text.p: Jason Inc said Friday it reached an agreement to acquire Buller Buff Co, a Canadian manufacturer of buffing wheels and other products for the metal finishing industry. Terms were not disclosed.

Buller Buff will become part of Jason's JacksonLea unit, the largest maker of buffing wheels and buffing compounds in North America, Jason said. Members of the founding Buller family will remain with the business, Jason said.
Jason is a diversified manufacturing company with operations in 11 states.
Its shares were trading down 3/8 Friday at 6-5/8.
